description: Corporate actions of US-listed companies from their own SEC EDGAR filings (8-Ks of US companies, 6-Ks of foreign private issuers): cash dividends (amount in the stated currency, per share or per ADS, ex, record and payment dates), stock splits, reverse splits and completed mergers (cash or shares per share). Filter by holdings (tickers, CIKs or FIGIs), by days (any of an event's dates between from and to) and by type. Each event links its filing and the sentence or table row it was read from. Also gives the iCalendar subscription URL for the same holdings and types (calendarUrl in structuredContent).

holdings.description: Tickers, SEC CIKs or FIGIs (optional; none means every company).

name: list_corporate_actions
title: Dividends, splits and mergers
